title: Layer 0: resolve deferred driver-key remediation (the driver-key leak, 2026-05-28 security review)
description: The 2026-05-28 identity-leak incident's second failure mode remains unremediated: .crosslink/driver-key.pub is a tracked file on public main (since the substrate deploy commit b3d6e50) carrying an SSH public key sourced by crosslink init from the user's default key without a selection prompt — its comment references a different pseudonymous context, and the key bytes are linkable across any other publication of the same key. Also present in the vsdd-cli-wip sibling tree (Layer 0 retirement act must account for it). Blocked on: operator's cross-persona key-publication audit. Resolution options: (a) swap to the project-intended key + untrack + ignore going forward (history retains the old blob); (b) full history rewrite + force-push (heavy; invalidates clones; needs its own plan). Upstream filings covering the mechanism: FM1/FM2 drafts pending operator review this session. Source records: review-log/2026-05-28-security.md (vsdd-cli-wip; preserved at 76ab1eb), operator decision on #597 2026-07-20. Keep sensitive strings out of this issue per the incident report's discipline.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Upstream filings now live for the mechanism this issue remediates locally: dollspace-gay/crosslink#28 (the driver-key leak — sourcing, selection, ignore-template asks) and #27 (the agent-key leak sibling). Local remediation here stays blocked on the operator's cross-persona audit; the bundled rewrite decision with #657 is the resolution vehicle.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Scope addition for the bundled rewrite decision: origin/wip-archive is a PUBLIC pushed branch of this repo carrying the full wip history — including the driver-key.pub blob this issue remediates. A main-only rewrite would leave the blob reachable via that ref; the bundle (with #657's trailer stripping) must include or delete wip-archive, or the purge is incomplete. Noted during the act-7 retirement verification, 2026-07-20.

comments.author: xqjG
